question: Three cubes each of volume 4096 cm³ are joined end to end to form a new solid. What is the surface area of the new solid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of each cube, a = ³√4096 = 16 cm.

When 3 cubes are joined end-to-end, 4 faces are completely hidden from the surface (2 joints × 2 faces).

Total Surface Area = Total area of 3 separate cubes − Area of hidden faces

TSA = 3 × 6a² − 4a² = 18a² − 4a² = 14a²

⇒ TSA = 14 × (16)² = 14 × 256 = 3584 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3584 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of each cube = 4096 cm³

Number of identical cubes joined = 3

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = a³

Total Surface Area of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 4096

⇒ a = 16 cm

⇒ Length of the new cuboid (l) = 16 + 16 + 16 = 48 cm

⇒ Breadth of the new cuboid (b) = 16 cm

⇒ Height of the new cuboid (h) = 16 cm

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2(48 × 16 + 16 × 16 + 16 × 48)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2(768 + 256 + 768)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2(1792)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 3584 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3584 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cube & Cuboid

The volume of a cube is given by a³ and for a cuboid it is length × breadth × height.

Surface Area Properties

The Total Surface Area of a single cube is 6a². When **n** identical cubes are joined end-to-end, 2(n − 1) faces get hidden inside the solid. The new surface area becomes n × 6a² − 2(n − 1)a².

Face Diagonal & Body Diagonal

The face diagonal of a cube is a√2, while the longest distance (body diagonal) inside a cube is a√3. For a cuboid, the body diagonal is calculated as √(l² + b² + h²).
